status: INFO ONLY: ES and NQ 2011-2026 are spent for the IV-wall family (and NQ for every breakout family tried). No gate, no adoption; the only clean test of this mechanism is a market it has not seen (GC/6E/ZN).
origin: User: 'can you try it on NQ and ES anyways' — ATR / Keltner-channel versions of the frozen IV-wall break, after being told the IV wall is a volatility-scaled breakout.

cells.hv: sigma = prior RTH close x stdev(20 daily log returns of RTH closes); walls = prior close +/- sigma. The frozen IV wall with the vol-index half removed.
cells.atr: unit = ATR(20) of RTH sessions (true range against the session's prior RTH close; plain high-low when that is missing, e.g. roll days); walls = prior close +/- 1 ATR.
cells.keltner: daily Keltner channel: centre = EMA(20) of RTH closes (alpha 2/21, seeded with the first close), unit = ATR(10); walls = centre +/- 2 ATR(10). On a roll session the EMA is shifted by (roll-session open - last close of the old contract) before use.

trade: identical to the frozen IV-wall break (IVGrid touch / fixed 2R / 0.4): 1-bar buy stop at U / sell stop at L at the nearer untouched wall from 09:35, stop 0.4 x unit back inside (unit = sigma, ATR(20) or ATR(10)), target 2R, flat 15:55, each wall once a session, skip the session if it opens outside the band or has no prior close (roll day).
control: ivwall: the frozen IV-wall break (VXN for NQ, VIX for ES) on the same sessions.
evaluator: frozen research_loop.eval (ES, MES) and research_loop_nq.eval (NQ, MNQ): base/stress costs, side-matched random-direction twin.
windows: dev 2011-2018, val1 2019-2021, val2 2022-2026-08-14 for each product, reported separately and pooled.
reports: per cell x product x window: n, net R, gross R, CI, stress R, twin p, USD at 1 micro; by year; longs/shorts; same-day-side overlap with the IV wall; median band width in IV-wall sigma.
